local_group_source: McConnachie 2012, AJ 144, 4 (The observed properties of dwarf galaxies in and around the Local Group), updated catalogue NearbyGalaxies_Jan2021_PUBLIC.fits
local_group_notes: Distance from the distance modulus (m-M)0, D = 10^((m-M)/5 + 1) pc, with its quoted errors. Absolute V magnitude = V - (m-M)0 - 3.1 E(B-V) (Schlegel et al. 1998 reddening, as the catalogue gives it); where E(B-V) > 0.3 (the Magellanic Clouds, IC 10 behind the Galactic plane) the map is unreliable and no correction is applied. A leading * on a name in the catalogue is kept as flag_star.

landmarks.name: Virgo Cluster (M87)
landmarks.method: surface brightness fluctuations of 84 early-type members
landmarks.fact: about 1,500 galaxies; 2.4 ± 0.4 Mpc deep, front to back

landmarks.name: Norma Cluster (Abell 3627)
landmarks.fact: the Great Attractor's core, half hidden behind the Milky Way's plane (Kraan-Korteweg et al. 1996)
landmarks.source: Woudt et al. 2008, MNRAS 383, 445; Mutabazi et al. 2014

landmarks.name: Local Void (direction)
landmarks.method: an approximate direction: estimates of its centre range from l = 18° to 60°
landmarks.fact: starts about 1 Mpc from us; its centre is at least 23 Mpc away; the Local Sheet moves away from it at about 260 km/s
landmarks.source: Tully et al. 2008, ApJ 676, 184; Tully et al. 2019, ApJ 880, 24

landmarks.name: Laniakea (toward its core)
landmarks.method: the basin of attraction of Cosmicflows-2 peculiar velocities
landmarks.fact: our supercluster: about 160 Mpc across, 10^17 solar masses, about 100,000 galaxies; its gravitational centre lies near the Great Attractor (direction drawn toward the Norma Cluster)
